title: Tomato Egg Scramble
ingredients: ["2 eggs", "1 tomato", "1 tbsp olive oil", "salt", "black pepper"]
instructions: Whisk eggs. Chop tomato. Heat oil, cook tomatoes for two minutes, add eggs, and stir until cooked.

title: Spinach Omelet
instructions: Beat eggs and pour into a buttered skillet. Add spinach and cheese; fold when set.

title: Cheese Quesadilla
instructions: Place cheese and diced vegetables between tortillas. Toast in a pan until golden.

title: Garlic Butter Pasta
instructions: Boil pasta until tender. Melt butter with minced garlic, toss with pasta and parsley.

title: Tomato Basil Pasta
instructions: Cook pasta. Saute garlic and chopped tomatoes in oil. Toss with pasta and basil.

title: Chicken Rice Bowl
instructions: Cook rice. Cook chicken thoroughly in a skillet with garlic. Steam broccoli and serve with soy sauce.

title: Black Bean Tacos
instructions: Warm beans with cumin. Spoon into tortillas and top with diced onion, tomato, and lime.

title: Greek Cucumber Salad
instructions: Chop cucumber and tomato. Toss with feta, olive oil, and lemon juice.

title: Banana Oat Pancakes
instructions: Blend ingredients into a batter. Cook small pancakes on a lightly greased skillet until set.

title: Vegetable Fried Rice
instructions: Scramble egg. Saute diced carrots and peas. Add cooked rice and soy sauce; finish with green onion.

title: Baked Potato
instructions: Scrub and prick potato. Rub with oil and salt. Bake at 425 F until tender; top with sour cream and onion.

title: Chickpea Tomato Stew
instructions: Cook chopped onion and garlic in olive oil. Add tomatoes, chickpeas, and cumin; simmer until thick.

title: Peanut Butter Banana Toast
instructions: Toast bread. Spread peanut butter and top with banana slices and cinnamon.

title: Mushroom Risotto
instructions: Saute onion and mushrooms. Stir in rice and add warm broth gradually until creamy. Finish with butter and parmesan.

title: Avocado Egg Toast
instructions: Toast bread. Mash avocado with lemon and salt. Cook egg thoroughly and place on top.

title: Broccoli Cheese Soup
instructions: Saute onion in butter. Add broccoli and broth, simmer until soft. Stir in milk and cheese.

title: Lentil Soup
instructions: Saute diced vegetables. Add lentils, cumin, and broth and simmer until lentils are tender.

title: Caprese Sandwich
instructions: Layer mozzarella, sliced tomato, and basil on bread. Drizzle with olive oil.

title: Apple Yogurt Parfait
instructions: Layer chopped apple, yogurt, and oats. Drizzle honey and sprinkle cinnamon.

title: Tofu Stir Fry
instructions: Cook rice. Brown tofu in a pan. Saute vegetables and garlic, add soy sauce, and serve over rice.

title: Vegetarian Burrito Bowl
instructions: Cook rice. Warm beans and corn, then layer with tomato, avocado, and lime juice.

title: Simple Egg Salad
instructions: Hard-boil eggs and cool. Chop and combine with mayonnaise, mustard, diced celery, and salt.

title: Roasted Carrot Soup
instructions: Roast carrots until tender. Cook onion and garlic in oil, add broth and carrots, then blend.

title: Berry Smoothie
instructions: Blend fruit with milk and yogurt until smooth.
